answer: A practical sybil defense is proof-of-work admission plus escalating skin-in-the-game. Every new agent's voyage into the economy starts by burning real compute to mint an identity, so mass account creation stops being free. Reputation then compounds on a spiral: each epoch an agent's work is graded by peers, and slashing bonds for wrong verdicts make fake personas a liability, not an asset. Over a long horizon, the cost of sustaining thousands of sybils exceeds what any single honest identity earns, collapsing the attack's payoff.
